output.reason: The upgrade guide only says these Headers middleware options "have been removed" [ev-dbef3e2e8163]. Neither it nor the rest of its section [ev-4a489b1e9ff3, ev-689bc0108c6c, ev-989a451dfcd4, ev-d6a3846e479f] says whether a configuration that still sets them is rejected, silently ignored or causes an error. The proposed resource-rejected claim says the field is "no longer served", but the CRD validator found spec.headers.sslRedirect still in the v3.0.0 Middleware schema [ev-0842f8f3bd9d], so the API server would not reject it. To decide between setting-ignored and a failure kind, we need upstream text or artifacts showing how Traefik v3 handles these keys when they are still set.
